title: Q2 两级调度：卡车跨区 + 三轮车区内
summary: The T018 plan has zero zone-level unmet but leaves 239,245 cell-level departures unserved (11.2% of 2,132,542) once the zone inventory is followed cell by cell: the static arrival-surface split gives a lower bound of 115,129 (5.4%) because it re-splits each zone's bikes every hour for free, while the dynamic model with no within-zone rebalancing gives 239,245. A per-zone hourly transportation LP with tricycle time budgets then reduces cell-level unserved from 239,245 to 51,165 (188,081 fewer). The optimal integer allocation is 728 tricycles (all 50 zones, median 17, max 20 per zone), moving 142,184 bikes and 75,051 vehicle-km for 233,410 CNY/day (218,400 fixed + 15,010 mileage); residual cell unmet 51,165 (2.4%). Total cost = 83,808 truck objective + 233,410 tricycle + 306,987 unmet penalty = 624,205 vs 1,519,279 truck-only, a saving of 895,074 CNY/day (58.9%). Break-even: the layer pays for itself as long as one unserved trip is worth more than 1.24 CNY (the model uses 6), or a tricycle-day costs less than 1,530 CNY (the assumption is 300). A complete executable schedule for zone 0 (20 allocated + 2 dispatch buffer tricycles, 436 trips) has zero unassigned trips, max load 20 bikes and last completion 19.45 h inside the 07:00-20:00 shift.

notes: Walking is inert at the cell resolution: cell centres are 426 m (E-W) by 556 m (N-S) apart, so a 300 m radius contains no other cell centre. The 300 m walking term therefore serves nothing and cell-level unmet equals the strict value. This is consistent with T004's note that at R=300 m no neighbour is reachable; the tricycle layer is the only within-zone instrument in this model. A 450 m variant (the first radius that reaches an E-W neighbour) is not run here and would reduce both the baseline and the tricycle benefit.

Two cell-level numbers are reported because they answer different questions. The static 115,129 is the task's mandated disaggregation (zone stock split by the hourly arrival surface) and is a lower bound: it re-splits the zone's bikes every hour for free. The dynamic 239,245 follows the same stock cell by cell through the day with T018's truck flows and is the operational baseline the tricycle model improves.

The cell layer reproduces T018's zone totals exactly by construction: truck pickups are taken pro-rata to stock, drops and arrivals are distributed by Pcell, whose zone sums equal T018's PZ to 7.7e-7. Cell-level lost trips do not feed back into arrivals (a lost trip would have produced an arrival in another cell); the bias is at most the unmet share, 2-11%, and is documented rather than iterated.

Tricycle parameters are planning assumptions because no public source was reachable in this run (WebSearch and the paper-search API were both unavailable). The delivery therefore reports the break-even values that make the conclusion robust: the fleet pays for itself for any fixed cost below 1,530 CNY per tricycle-day (assumed 300) and any penalty above 1.24 CNY per unserved trip (assumed 6.00).
The 6 CNY penalty is T018's zone-level service penalty, reused unchanged at cell level. It is not an estimate of welfare; the break-even penalty is the transferable number.

The optimal fleet sits at the boundary of the per-zone curve for some zones (max 20 tricycles in the densest zones), so the residual 51,165 unmet is partly a capacity limit of the per-zone grid and partly the absence of donors in fully drained zones. Extending the per-zone bound above 20 would lower the residual further; the DP is saturated at 728 because the marginal tricycle at that point saves less than its 300 CNY/day.

The compare.json column pre_tricycle_shortfall is measured along the with-tricycle stock path: it sums each hour's (departures - hour-start stock) before that hour's tricycle moves, so bikes prepositioned in earlier hours already lower it. It is a diagnostic of where the within-hour LP bites, not the no-tricycle counterfactual; that counterfactual is no_tricycle.cell_unmet = 239,245.2. The headline reduction is no_tricycle.cell_unmet - cell_unmet = 188,080.7.

The schedule sample uses a 10% dispatch buffer (22 tricycles for an allocation of 20) to absorb deadhead and load imbalance; the cost table does not include this buffer, a 600 CNY/day difference in that zone.

The comparison holds the T018 truck plan fixed (sequential two-tier). An integrated model could also re-optimise the trucks knowing the tricycles exist; that is out of scope and would lower the truck cost, strengthening the two-tier conclusion.
